verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports confirm Ollama's own CLI downloads models with 'ollama pull' and removes them with 'ollama rm', and users single out model management as its strength. The search part of the story is not evidenced, and first-party docs in the pack do not describe the CLI model-management commands. Missing for 10: CLI model search/discovery, first-party documentation of pull/list/rm commands.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface

citations.quote: One 'ollama pull' and it's available. Underwhelming? 'ollama rm'.
combined with simple 'ollama pull model'—very convenient for a discord bot with different models per feature.
llama.cpp does almost everything ollama does better except model management.
